title.zh: Ondo launches onchain portfolio tokens based on BlackRock-developed strategies

current_state.zh: Ondo launched three onchain portfolio tokens that track model portfolio strategies developed by BlackRock, deepening the link between tokenized onchain products and traditional asset-management strategies.
